california-mount-tam-and-point-reyes.slogan: Redwoods, coast and a short ride that feels expensive.
california-mount-tam-and-point-reyes.story: Redwoods, coast and a short ride that feels expensive. A 140 km loop that starts and ends near Kentfield, about 2 h 42 of riding. On the way it passes Stinson Beach, Point Reyes Station and Tomales Bay. The climb of the day is Mount Tamalpais. It is a high-mountain day.
